gap: No result ChatGPT got says that Rexing's 360° Smart Hardwire Kit is for gasoline vehicles only and is not supported on hybrids or EVs. Rexing sells it as fitting 95% of its dash cams, excluding only 4G LTE units, the R4-RD and Multimedia Receivers, so it covers the R4 Pro that ChatGPT made its top pick, and the R4 Pro needs a hardwire kit for parking mode. Vantrue's N5S kits are rated for any 12–24 V vehicle and list no gasoline-only limit.
standout_why: Dashlore (cited) mentions only the Vantrue N5S. It says parking mode 'needs a hardwire kit, sold separately', names no kit, says nothing about a vehicle-type limit, and covers no Rexing model. ChatGPT's own answers say the R4 and R4 Pro have parking mode, with no word on which kit it takes or on hybrids and EVs. Car and Driver (cited) would not load (the fetch tool is blocked from caranddriver.com), so I could not check it; the parts of it that ChatGPT quoted cover only the N5S cabin cameras. I did not open the uncited top results (Tom's Guide, mydrivecar, gearjury, caraudioradar).
decides: For a gas car the R4 Pro and R4 picks stand, and buyers should take the R4 bundle: it costs the same $259.99 as the bare R4 and adds the hardwire kit, GPS and a 64 GB card. For a hybrid or EV owner who wants parking mode, Rexing's 360° kit is ruled out by Rexing's own listing. That pushes them to the Vantrue N5S with its VP03 bundle or Vantrue's 12–24 V kits, or to one of Rexing's fuse or OBD Type-C kits, none of which names the R4 Pro. One limit on all of this: none of the N5S, Nexus 5, R4 or R4 Pro has separate exterior side cameras. The R4's left and right lenses rotate (they are not separate cameras), and Rexing describes the R4 as two units to install.

findings.value: Gasoline vehicles only; 'not supported for hybrid or pure electric vehicles'
findings.source_title: Rexing Smart Hardwire Kit with 360° Motion Detection
findings.note: Read from the Rexing store's product data with storecheck.py. Quote: 'Note: This product is compatible with gasoline vehicles only. It is currently not supported for hybrid or pure electric vehicles.' 13 ft cable. Price $39.99 (list $59.99).

findings.label: Rexing 360° Smart Hardwire Kit: models covered and excluded
findings.value: 'Compatible with 95% of Rexing Dash Cams'; excludes 4G LTE, R4-RD and Multimedia Receiver units
findings.source_title: Rexing Smart Hardwire Kit with 360° Motion Detection
findings.note: The listing does not name the R4 Pro, R4 or C4. They fall inside the kit's coverage only because they are not on the exclusion list.

findings.label: Parking mode requirement and price
findings.source_title: Rexing R4 Pro 2K Front + 1080p*3 4CH Dash Cam, WiFi, GPS, Loop Recording, Parking Mode, G-Sensor
findings.note: Read from Rexing store product data with storecheck.py. No hardwire kit is included, and the listing does not name a specific kit.

findings.label: Max microSD
findings.note: Quote: 'The camera supports cards up to 256GB.' The page also says parking recording may need a firmware update if the function does not appear on the camera.

findings.label: Rexing Type-C fuse hardwire kits: models named
findings.value: $29.99 kit: R4, DT2, M3, M2 Max, M2-4, M4-4, RH2. $39.99 kit with GPS logger: 'ONLY R4 dash cam, L4 Series and RH2 Series'
findings.source_title: Rexing Dash Cam Smart Hardwire Kit, Type-C Hard Wire Kit Fuse Only for R4, DT2, M3, M2 Max, M2-4, M4-4, and RH2 Series
findings.note: Both kits take 12–30 V input, give 5 V/2 A out and cut off at 11.8 V / 23.5 V. Neither listing names the R4 Pro or C4. The GPS-logger version is at https://rexing.com/products/rexing-dash-cam-smart-hardwire-kit-with-gps-logger-type-c-hard-wire-kit-fuse-only-for-r4-dashcam-rexing-12v-30v-to-5v-2a-type-c-port-charger-power-cord-gift-8-fuse-tap-cable-and-installation-tool-11-5ft

findings.label: Rexing OBD hardwire kit: models named
findings.value: RH2, V1P Flex X4, M2 Max, M3, R316, M2 Max Pro, M2-4, M4-4, 'R4 Series'; 5 V/3 A; 10.5 ft; $24.99
findings.source_title: Rexing Dash Cam Hardwire Kit with OBD Interface
findings.note: The listing says it 'works with all Rexing dash cams featuring a Type-C power port' and gives no vehicle-fuel exclusion. Whether 'R4 Series' takes in the R4 Pro is not stated.

findings.label: Bundle with hardwire kit at the bare-camera price
findings.value: $259.99 for R4 + Smart Hardwire Kit + GPS + 64 GB card, the same as the R4 alone ($259.99)
findings.source_title: Rexing 4-Channel 1080p Dash Cam Bundle with GPS, 64GB Card & Hardwire Kit
findings.note: Bare R4 at $259.99 (list $299.99) from https://rexing.com/products/rexing-r4-4-channel-dash-cam-w-all-around-1080p-resolution-wi-fi-and-gps-1, which also gives microSD 'up to 256GB' and CPL filter included. The bundle listing does not say which hardwire kit it includes.

findings.label: Camera layout
findings.value: Left and right side cameras rotate 180° and can be turned to face the cabin; 4 IR lights on each; 'only two units to install'
findings.source_title: The Rexing R4 Enhanced IR Dash Cam Captures 4-Channels All In Real HD
findings.note: Two units means the main unit plus the separate rear camera. Rexing sells the R4 rear camera as a separate part, 'Rear Camera for R4, V1PFlex X4, R316 Series, and RH2 Series' ($39.99, rexing.com/products/rexing-rear-camera-for-r4-v1pflex-x4-r316-series-and-rh2-series), and that listing says it is compatible with those models ONLY. So the R4 has no separate exterior side cameras.

findings.label: CPL filter exclusion
findings.value: R4 CPL filter fits the R4 only; 'doesn't work for other Rexing dash cams'; $19.99
findings.source_title: Rexing Ultra-Slim CPL Circular Polarizer Filter for R4 Dash Cam
findings.note: Read from Rexing store product data.

findings.label: Hardwire and parking
findings.value: Smart Hardwire Kit and built-in 360° motion parking monitor included; $279.99; excluded from the separate 360° kit
findings.source_title: Rexing R4-RD 4-Channel Dash Cam with All-Around 1080p, Built-in 360° Parking Monitor, Wi-Fi, GPS, IR Night Vision
findings.note: Side cameras 'can also rotate inward for optional cabin monitoring.' The listing gives no fuel or vehicle-type limit for the included kit.

findings.label: Parking kit and GPS add-on
findings.value: Parking mode requires a Smart Hardwire Kit (sold separately); GPS comes only through the Type-C Inline GPS Adapter ($19.99); camera $199.99 with 64 GB card
findings.source_title: Rexing C4 4-Channel Dash Cam with All-Around 1080p, Wi-Fi App Control, Parking Mode, 64GB Card
findings.note: The adapter listing (rexing.com/products/rexing-type-c-gps-logger-attachment-add-on-...) lists V1P FLEX X4, RH2-4, L4, L4-2K, C4 and C1 Plus, and says it works with a Type-C charger, the Type-C Smart Hardwire Kit or the IHWK-360 kit. It also says 'A Type-C port alone does not establish compatibility.'

findings.label: Parking kit, card limit and price
findings.value: Vantrue bundles the VP03 hardwire kit with the N5S; microSD up to 1 TB; $293.99
findings.note: From Vantrue store search data. N5S + VP03 + 256 GB + CPL bundle is $519.99 (vantrue.com/products/bundle-n5s-vp03-hardwire-kit-256gb-card-cpl). Vantrue's Voltage Display Hardwire Kit ($29.99) lists the N5S and is rated for '12–24 V' vehicles; no gasoline-only exclusion appears on Vantrue's kit listings.

findings.label: 4G LTE module compatibility
findings.value: 4G LTE Module ($149.99) lists S1 Pro, N2X, E360, E360 Ace, S1 Pro Max, N4S, E1 Pro, N5S, N4PS; the original N5 is not listed
findings.source_title: Vantrue 4G LTE Module with SIM Card
findings.note: The included SIM has 300 MB of data to start, then the buyer tops it up. Remote viewing therefore needs the N5S, not the N5.

findings.label: Card limit and extended rear cable
findings.value: microSD up to 512 GB (N5S: 1 TB); 49.2 ft (15 m) rear cable fits N5 and N5S only, $19.99
findings.source_title: 49.2ft Rear Camera Cable for N5 | N5S
findings.note: The cable listing says 'Not compatible with other Vantrue dash cams.' The N5's 512 GB limit and $265.99 price come from Vantrue's store data for https://www.vantrue.com/products/nexus-5.
